title: Borrowing and answering for another
literal_meaning: I would borrow, but would not become surety for someone else.
explanation: The dictionary’s inline explanation distinguishes taking a loan from guaranteeing another person. The first-person voice accepts one involvement and refuses the other. Our reading hears a boundary between bearing one’s own obligation and answering for someone else; it does not turn that preference into a rule everyone should follow.
meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନର ସଂଲଗ୍ନ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଋଣ ନେବା ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଜାମିନ ହେବାକୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ। ବକ୍ତା ଗୋଟିଏ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ପଶିବାକୁ ମାନେ, ଅନ୍ୟଟିକୁ ମନା କରେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ନିଜ ଦାୟ ନେବା ଓ ପର ପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ତରଦାୟୀ ହେବା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସୀମା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ; ସେ ପସନ୍ଦ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ନିୟମ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our reading hears a speaker distinguishing two kinds of obligation.
odia_summary: ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରକାର ଦାୟକୁ ଅଲଗା କରୁଥିବା ବକ୍ତାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ଶୁଣେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “କଥାଟିରେ ଋଣଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଦାୟର ଭେଦ ମୋତେ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଛି।” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ନିଜ ପାଇଁ କହିବା ଓ ପର ପାଇଁ କଥା ଦେବା କି ଏକା?” / A reading group discusses the difference between speaking for oneself and giving one’s word for someone else. This discussion is invented, not borrowing advice.
cultural_context: Sambalpur labels the dictionary’s verb, not a proven saying origin. The gloss supplies surety; this historical wording offers no present financial or legal guidance.
